weapons.name: Anaconda
weapons.source_note: SECONDARY SOURCE (NRA magazine review). Quote: "The Colt Anaconda has a 1:20-inch LH twist, whereas Colt's competitors use right-hand rifling twists in their .44 Mags." States a left-hand 1 turn in 20 inch twist = 508.0 mm per turn. No manufacturer document found: Colt's own operator manuals (Double Action Revolvers manual, 2004 edition) and Colt catalogues and product pages do not print pistol twist rates.

weapons.name: Carbon Fury .300 PRC
weapons.source_note: Fierce Firearms Carbon Fury manufacturer page, CALIBERS list: "6.5 PRC (twist: 1-8 | barrel: 24\")" and ".300 PRC (twist: 1-9 | barrel: 24\")". States the .300 PRC barrel has 1 turn in 9 inches = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Firefly .22 LR compact pistol, SIG Mosquito-style
weapons.source_note: German Sport Guns (GSG) product page, technical data table for the GSG FireFly: "Dralllänge: 406 mm" (twist length 406 mm) and "Züge: 6" (6 grooves). States one turn in 406 mm with 6 grooves.

weapons.name: FNP-45 Tactical Pistol
weapons.source_note: FNP-45 owner's manual (2009, covers Standard, Competition and Tactical), specification block: "Number of grooves : 6" and "Twist and direction : 1:16\", right-hand". States 1 turn in 16 inches right-hand = 406.4 mm per turn, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: Gold Cup 1911 National Match, 5" barrel, adjustable trigger
weapons.source_note: SECONDARY SOURCE (NRA magazine review, named model Gold Cup). Quote: "The barrel is Colt's National Match and uses a six groove right hand 1:16 twist in .45 ACP". States a 6-groove 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 406.4 mm per turn. No manufacturer document found: the Colt Gold Cup National Match MK IV/Series 70 operator's manual carries no twist specification.

weapons.name: K1A1 Carbine
weapons.source_note: Daewoo AR110C operator's manual, SPECIFICATIONS, barrel rifling: "number of grooves 6", "twist of rifling right hand", "pitch of rifling 185mm (7.3\")". The AR-110C is the imported commercial K1A1 (K1 carbine) designation. States 185 mm per turn, right-hand, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: M3 Grease Gun Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: FM 23-41, general data, barrel (.45 caliber): "Number of grooves ....... 4" and "Twist in rifling, uniform, right one turn in ... 16" (inches). States 1 turn in 16 inches right-hand = 406.4 mm per turn, 4 grooves.
